minecraft:fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
minecraft:fishing_rod.desc: A simple fishing rod used for catching the most basic of fishes. One can only dream of upgrading it to a <sclegendary>Starcatcher's rod</sclegendary>.

modifiers.text: Allows for lava-fishing
Perfect catches are 10% more likely to become golden
Your catches will roll for quality an extra 5 times
Adjusts the hp of fish by 75%

starcatcher:agave_bream.name: Agave Bream
starcatcher:agave_bream.desc: A rare bream which emerges only on clear nights. Its long fins help it navigate the murky waters of desert oases. It is said to have a fondness for mangosteens.

starcatcher:almighty_worm.name: Almighty Worm
obtain: Bonemealing farmland may provide you with a few different items.

Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 80%

If available, will catch the live fish instead

starcatcher:amethystback.name: Amethystback
starcatcher:amethystback.desc: A rare hard to catch fish common close to amethyst geodes.

starcatcher:aquamarine_pike.name: Aquamarine Pike
starcatcher:aquamarine_pike.desc: A predatory fish found at deepslate level.

starcatcher:aurora.name: Aurora
starcatcher:aurora.desc: The most beautiful <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish there is. Its size and crystal-frozen body make it one of the most elusive catches known.

starcatcher:azure_crystalback_minnow.name: Azure Crystalback Minnow
starcatcher:azure_crystalback_minnow.desc: A rare mutation of the crystalback minnow which glows a soft blue tone at midnight. A challenging catch due to its tiny size.

starcatcher:bigeye_tuna.name: Bigeye Tuna
starcatcher:bigeye_tuna.desc: A big heavy fish known for its big eye. This species is only found in deep ocean waters. It's said to hang around other Kaupen fish.

starcatcher:black_eel.name: Black Eel
starcatcher:black_eel.desc: A carnivorous black eel common underground.

starcatcher:blossomfish.name: Blossomfish
starcatcher:blossomfish.desc: A beautiful fish resembling the pink petals of cherry groves. It prefers to swim around in the warm sunlight.

starcatcher:blue_crystal_fin.name: Blue Crystal Fin
starcatcher:blue_crystal_fin.desc: An uncommon fish most commonly found during daytime.

starcatcher:blue_herring.name: Blue Herring
starcatcher:blue_herring.desc: A very illusive fish, always searching for the 46th ocean. Fishermen use it for directions, as it always goes back to where it all started.

starcatcher:blue_ice_pike.name: Blue Ice Pike
starcatcher:blue_ice_pike.desc: A predatory fish with scales resembling blue ice. It vanishes into the frozen waters at the first sign of danger.

starcatcher:bluegigi.name: Bluegigi
starcatcher:bluegigi.desc: Not to be confused with a bluegill, this small fish is rather common around rivers.

starcatcher:bobber.name: Bobber
starcatcher:bobber.desc: A basic bobber for your fishing rod. Hook's best friend.

starcatcher:boot.name: Boot
starcatcher:boot.desc: An incredibly high quality boot fished from a lake. Every fisherman's dream.

starcatcher:boreal.name: Boreal
starcatcher:boreal.desc: A fish found in icy mountain lakes. Its crystal-covered body blends seamlessly into the water, making it a true challenge even for seasoned anglers.

starcatcher:bottled_letter.name: Bottled Letter
starcatcher:bottled_letter.desc: A letter imprisoned in a bottle. The only thing left to do now is throw it into the ocean and let it start its journey.

starcatcher:brassgill.name: Brassgill
starcatcher:brassgill.desc: A mechanical construct resembling the embergill, made to survive high temperature fluids. Its use is unknown.

starcatcher:bright_amethyst_snapper.name: Bright Amethyst Snapper
starcatcher:bright_amethyst_snapper.desc: A gorgeous pink colored fish found at deepslate level. It's said to always swim around with a dark amethyst snapper.

starcatcher:broken_bottle.name: Broken Bottle
starcatcher:broken_bottle.desc: A broken bottle reminiscing the times it was unbroken. Some things never go back to the way they were before.

starcatcher:cactifish.name: Cactifish
starcatcher:cactifish.desc: Despite its name, it is not connected to cacti in any way. Its green colored scales simply resemble the colors of a cactus.

starcatcher:carpenjoe.name: Carpenjoe
starcatcher:carpenjoe.desc: A majestic carp glowing in modding knowledge. It is said anglers eat it for good luck before debugging.

starcatcher:cerberay.name: Cerberay
starcatcher:cerberay.desc: A stinging fish with 3 heads. The 2 smaller ones only share 1 brain.

starcatcher:charfish.name: Charfish
starcatcher:charfish.desc: A purple fish only found in the End.

modifiers.text: Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 70%
Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 80%
Adjusts the chance of biting every tick by 130%
Cherry grove fish will be more likely to bite

starcatcher:chorus_crab.name: Chorus Crab
starcatcher:chorus_crab.desc: This crab species uses chorus fruit as its main source of food. It is said that it can teleport around at will after feeding.

starcatcher:chorus_minnow.name: Chorus Minnow
starcatcher:chorus_minnow.desc: A species of minnow consumed by chorus. It is unknown if they are native to the End.

starcatcher:cinder_squid.name: Cinder Squid
starcatcher:cinder_squid.desc: A slippery squid found in the Nether.

starcatcher:clam.name: Clam
starcatcher:clam.desc: Once a bivalve mollusk living in the sandy shores, now just a shell.

modifiers.text: Adjusts the vanishing rate of sweet-spots by 30%
Your bobber will no longer follow the laws of gravity

starcatcher:cloudfin.name: Cloudfin
starcatcher:cloudfin.desc: A <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish known for carrying your data up to the clouds. It is said only the worst of anglers manage to catch them, but no one knows why.

starcatcher:coggill.name: Coggill
starcatcher:coggill.desc: A dusty construct made of brass gears and cogs often used in arid areas to move air around.

starcatcher:cogtopus.name: Cogtopus
starcatcher:cogtopus.desc: A very intelligent machine made to mimic the behaviour of octopuses. Each of its brains (cogs) controls a different arm, making it able to maneuver anywhere it pleases.

starcatcher:conch.name: Conch
starcatcher:conch.desc: The remains of a mollusk with a spiral shell often used as an ornament.

starcatcher:cooked_starcaught_fish.name: Cooked Starcaught Fish
starcatcher:cooked_starcaught_fish.desc: A starcaught fish, but cooked. Nothing is unique about what remains of this once beautiful fish.

modifiers.text: Adjusts the handle's rotation speed by 150%

starcatcher:cryospine.name: Cryospine
starcatcher:cryospine.desc: A half-frozen fish often ignored due to its low nutritional value. It is said fishermen stuck on icebergs would catch 100 of them, just to make a single meal.

starcatcher:crystalback_boreal.name: Crystalback Boreal
starcatcher:crystalback_boreal.desc: Named after the Boreal, this fish is far easier to catch. Its crystal-covered back glitters brightly, making hiding nearly impossible.

starcatcher:crystalback_minnow.name: Crystalback Minnow
starcatcher:crystalback_minnow.desc: A really small fish often used as bait. This specific species is most common at nighttime.

starcatcher:crystalback_sturgeon.name: Crystalback Sturgeon
starcatcher:crystalback_sturgeon.desc: A sturgeon common to lakes high up on mountains. Its crystal-covered back turns away most attackers before they get close.

starcatcher:crystalback_trout.name: Crystalback Trout
starcatcher:crystalback_trout.desc: A hardy trout with a crystal-covered back. Few predators enjoy biting into it twice.

starcatcher:dark_amethyst_snapper.name: Dark Amethyst Snapper
starcatcher:dark_amethyst_snapper.desc: A gorgeous dark blue colored fish found at deepslate level. It's said to always swim around with a bright amethyst snapper.

starcatcher:deepjaw_herring.name: Deepjaw Herring
starcatcher:deepjaw_herring.desc: A fish common to oceans, often regarded highly for trading.

starcatcher:deepslatefish.name: Deepslatefish
starcatcher:deepslatefish.desc: A <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish only found high up in the mountains. Just kidding. It's found at deepslate. An incredibly tough catch due to its vanishing deepslate scales.

starcatcher:downfall_bream.name: Downfall Bream
starcatcher:downfall_bream.desc: A hard to spot but easy to catch bream, only coming out during rainy nights.

starcatcher:dreamliner.name: Dreamliner
starcatcher:dreamliner.desc: A fish found swimming through the endless void of the End. It's said to be a 787 in its past life.

starcatcher:dried_seaweed.name: Dried Seaweed
starcatcher:dried_seaweed.desc: A piece of dead seaweed which got caught up in your hook.

starcatcher:driftfin.name: Driftfin
starcatcher:driftfin.desc: A small fish which spends most of its time in Overworld lakes.

starcatcher:drifting_bream.name: Drifting Bream
starcatcher:drifting_bream.desc: A species of bream known for slowly drifting atop rivers during nighttime.

starcatcher:dripfin.name: Dripfin
starcatcher:dripfin.desc: A basic fish which inhabits the water pools of dripstone caves.

starcatcher:drive_pike.name: Drive Pike
starcatcher:drive_pike.desc: An aggressive machine made to control the fish population around rivers.

starcatcher:dusktail_snapper.name: Dusktail Snapper
starcatcher:dusktail_snapper.desc: A heavy fish for its size often used in dishes.

modifiers.text: Increases the base chance of every uncaught fish by an extra 15

starcatcher:eel_dynamo.name: Eel Dynamo
starcatcher:eel_dynamo.desc: A oily slippery eel ran by gears.

starcatcher:elderscale.name: Elderscale
starcatcher:elderscale.desc: A deceiving fish often found in lakes. Elderscales may live up to several decades but often spend their youth hiding. Spotting a young one is little more than a rumor, therefore its name.

starcatcher:embergill.name: Embergill
starcatcher:embergill.desc: A fish found in the vast lava oceans of the Nether.

starcatcher:end_glow.name: End Glow
starcatcher:end_glow.desc: A tricky fish only found in the End. Endermen don't seem to mind it.

modifiers.text: Adjusts the handle's rotation speed by 125%

starcatcher:fish_bones.name: Fish Bones
starcatcher:fish_bones.desc: Some fish bones. All that remains of a once happy fish.
obtain: Fish Bones are obtained after eating Starcaught Fish.

starcatcher:fish_radar.name: Fish Radar
starcatcher:fish_radar.desc: A handy radar which displays the fishes around the area in a totally futuristic way.

starcatcher:fossilized_angelfish.name: Fossilized Angelfish
starcatcher:fossilized_angelfish.desc: An angelfish resembling a fossil. It is not actually fossilised and is often ignored due to its low nutritional value, heavy weight, and high difficulty to catch.

starcatcher:frostbit_jelly.name: Frostbit Jelly
starcatcher:frostbit_jelly.desc: A jellyfish species which uses icebergs for long term hibernation. There they spend most of their life.

starcatcher:frostgill_chub.name: Frostgill Chub
starcatcher:frostgill_chub.desc: A popular fish amongst anglers which is commonly found in rivers.

starcatcher:frostjaw_trout.name: Frostjaw Trout
starcatcher:frostjaw_trout.desc: A trout species known for its razor-sharp jaws of petrified ice. Even the boldest predators think twice before biting one.

modifiers.text: Prevents your handle from freezing up

starcatcher:garnet_mackerel.name: Garnet Mackerel
starcatcher:garnet_mackerel.desc: An easy to catch mackerel species found deep in caves.

starcatcher:geode_eel.name: Geode Eel
starcatcher:geode_eel.desc: A shiny, heavy, long eel. Their color and texture comes from infused amethyst due to their eggs being hatched inside amethyst geodes.

starcatcher:ghostly_pike.name: Ghostly Pike
starcatcher:ghostly_pike.desc: A ghost-looking pike found deep underground.

starcatcher:glimmergill.name: Glimmergill
starcatcher:glimmergill.desc: This fish's scales are covered in a type of ice which reflects light in a very particular way. Curious prey wander into its body and get cut in its sharp scales.

modifiers.text: Adds a Glowing sweet-spot

starcatcher:glowing_dark.name: Glowing Dark
starcatcher:glowing_dark.desc: A fast fish only found in the deep dark.

starcatcher:glowstone_pufferfish.name: Glowstone Pufferfish
starcatcher:glowstone_pufferfish.desc: A pufferfish glittering just like glowstone.

starcatcher:glowstone_seeker.name: Glowstone Seeker
starcatcher:glowstone_seeker.desc: A fish which seems to be weirdly attracted to glowstone, usually swimming under it.

starcatcher:gold_fan.name: Gold Fan
starcatcher:gold_fan.desc: An underground fish with a tail that resembles a fan. As funny as it would be, it does not spin its tail like a fan to move around.

starcatcher:hollowbelly_darter.name: Hollowbelly Darter
starcatcher:hollowbelly_darter.desc: A really small easy to catch river fish.

starcatcher:hook.name: Iron Hook
starcatcher:hook.desc: A basic iron hook for your fishing rod. Everyone starts somewhere.

starcatcher:icetooth_sturgeon.name: Icetooth Sturgeon
starcatcher:icetooth_sturgeon.desc: A sturgeon found high up in the mountains. Its petrified ice teeth make short work of unwary prey.

starcatcher:ironjaw_herring.name: Ironjaw Herring
starcatcher:ironjaw_herring.desc: This type of herring is common to the ocean and often has a petrified silvery jaw resembling iron.

starcatcher:joel.name: Joel
starcatcher:joel.desc: A rare <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish found in oceans. It has a <sclegendary>nice</sclegendary> size.

starcatcher:king_of_the_frost.name: King of the Frost
starcatcher:king_of_the_frost.desc: The <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> King of the Frost, ruling over all the icebergs. Its tentacles wrap around pray and bring them to the depths of the oceans until they drown. Anglers are extremely cautious of it when sailing through the Icebergs of the Overworld.

starcatcher:lava_crab.name: Lava Crab
starcatcher:lava_crab.desc: This particular species of crab somehow entered the Nether and evolved a protective shell out of netherrack.

starcatcher:lava_crab_claw.name: Lava Crab Claw
starcatcher:lava_crab_claw.desc: A claw ripped off from a lava crab. Due to the aggressive nature of lava crabs, it's quite a common find in the Nether.

starcatcher:letter.name: Letter
starcatcher:letter.desc: A letter awaiting to be written and sent off.

starcatcher:lightning_bass.name: Lightning Bass
starcatcher:lightning_bass.desc: A rare species of bass drawn to flashes of lightning during thunderstorms. Often seen swimming alongside a Thunder Bass.

starcatcher:lilac_minnow.name: Lilac Minnow
starcatcher:lilac_minnow.desc: A species of minnow turned lilac due to the freezing temperatures it inhabits. Using it as bait is said to be the only way to catch a King of the Frost.

starcatcher:lily_snapper.name: Lily Snapper
starcatcher:lily_snapper.desc: A rare, long-bodied snapper found in swamps. It catches smaller fish with its long pointed mouth.

starcatcher:livid_bamboo.name: Livid Bamboo
starcatcher:livid_bamboo.desc: A piece of bamboo, but as a fish. Or so it is said.

modifiers.text: Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 70%

Lush cave fish will be more likely to bite

starcatcher:lush_pike.name: Lush Pike
starcatcher:lush_pike.desc: A mossy pike found rarely in the Lush Caves. A real tough catch even for experienced anglers.

starcatcher:magma_fish.name: Magma Fish
starcatcher:magma_fish.desc: A common Nether fish known for its red glowing fins.

starcatcher:mechanical_brass_snail.name: Mechanical Brass Snail
starcatcher:mechanical_brass_snail.desc: A machine made to clean oil off of beaches. This one seems to have been upgraded to brass, making it more efficient.

starcatcher:mechanical_snail.name: Mechanical Snail
starcatcher:mechanical_snail.desc: A machine made to clean oil off of beaches. It slowly moves back and forth cleaning up pollution, left behind by whoever made it.

starcatcher:meka_agave_bream.name: Meka Agave Bream
starcatcher:meka_agave_bream.desc: The mechanical version of an agave bream made for controlling bream population. If it's unable to find a suitable agave bream in time it will hibernate until next mating season.

starcatcher:message.name: Message
starcatcher:message.desc: The message half of a message-in-a-bottle. Who knows how long it's been drifting in the waves to reach you.

starcatcher:message_in_a_bottle.name: Message in a Bottle
starcatcher:message_in_a_bottle.desc: A bottle containing a message written many moons ago. Looks like the only way to get it out is to break it open.

modifiers.text: Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 70%
Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 80%
Adjusts the chance of biting every tick by 130%

starcatcher:mirage_carp.name: Mirage Carp
starcatcher:mirage_carp.desc: A carp species found on hot sunny days in warm climates. It's said desert villagers gave it its name, as spotting one was often just a mirage.

starcatcher:mistback_chub.name: Mistback Chub
starcatcher:mistback_chub.desc: A river fish known for its silver colored scales.

starcatcher:molten_deepslate_crab.name: Molten Deepslate Crab
starcatcher:molten_deepslate_crab.desc: A gold colored crab found at deepslate levels close to lava rivers.

starcatcher:molten_shrimp.name: Molten Shrimp
starcatcher:molten_shrimp.desc: A small shrimp found in lava rivers underground.

starcatcher:morganite.name: Morganite
starcatcher:morganite.desc: An ocean fish resembling morganite gemstones.

starcatcher:mossfin.name: Mossfin
starcatcher:mossfin.desc: Has strangely large eyes, serving no purpose beyond being cute. It enjoys all things bright and mossy. The only time it enters the shadows is to search for its shadowfin.

starcatcher:mossy_boot.name: Mossy Boot
starcatcher:mossy_boot.desc: A boot, but this time it's mossy!

modifiers.text: Perfect catches award treasure on a 20% chance

starcatcher:mothfish.name: Mothfish
starcatcher:mothfish.desc: This fish has developed a layer of fur to help it overcome the cold. How it keeps this fur dry in the first place is a mystery...

modifiers.text: Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 70%
Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 80%
Adjusts the chance of biting every tick by 130%
Swamp fish will be more likely to bite

starcatcher:nebula_squid.name: Nebula Squid
starcatcher:nebula_squid.desc: Unlike the cinder squid, nebula squids are quite sticky, and often use their tentacles to wrap around chorus fruits whilst feeding.

starcatcher:oasis_sturgeon.name: Oasis Sturgeon
starcatcher:oasis_sturgeon.desc: A majestic <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> sturgeon. So few have seen it that its existence is not fully confirmed. Legend claims every oasis is guarded by one silently watching beneath the waters.

starcatcher:obidontiee.name: Obidontiee
starcatcher:obidontiee.desc: A small devious fish. Said to often mispronounce words.

starcatcher:obsidian_crab.name: Obsidian Crab
starcatcher:obsidian_crab.desc: An illusive crab found close to underground lava pools.

starcatcher:obsidian_eel.name: Obsidian Eel
starcatcher:obsidian_eel.desc: A <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> species of eel made of obsidian, found during rainy days inside Overworld lava lakes. It often requires several anglers to carry it back to the village.

starcatcher:oculi.name: Oculi
starcatcher:oculi.desc: This weird fish reminds you of something you've seen before, yet you can't quite see it. Regardless, it is certainly a fish.

modifiers.text: Adjusts the handle's rotation speed by 50%

starcatcher:pale_carp.name: Pale Carp
starcatcher:pale_carp.desc: A carp species common to the [redacted]. Their habitat is still under construction in this universe, so instead they stick to the dark forest.

starcatcher:pale_pinfish.name: Pale Pinfish
starcatcher:pale_pinfish.desc: A tiny pale pinfish, only found around midnight in dark forests. It wishes to exist in a version where pale gardens exist.

starcatcher:peakdweller.name: Peakdweller
starcatcher:peakdweller.desc: A gold colored fish common to mountain lakes. It is usually ignored as its hard scales make for tough cuisine use.

starcatcher:pearl.name: Pearl
starcatcher:pearl.desc: A beautiful pearl obtained from a clam.
obtain: Clams placed on sand will slowly create pearls. Once the clam has opened up you may click on it to harvest a pearl.

starcatcher:pearl_smithing_template.name: Pearl Tackle Smithing Template
obtain: This template may be found rarely when collecting pearls from clams.

starcatcher:petal_bass.name: Petal Bass
starcatcher:petal_bass.desc: A species of bass adapted to live amongst the flowers of the Overworld.

starcatcher:petaldrift_carp.name: Petaldrift Carp
starcatcher:petaldrift_carp.desc: A pink carp common to cherry groves which prefers to come out during the rain.

starcatcher:phillipsfish.name: Phillipsfish
starcatcher:phillipsfish.desc: This machine drifts around the ocean and plugs itself wherever it can fit in.

starcatcher:pinfish.name: Pinfish
starcatcher:pinfish.desc: A tiny pale pinfish, only found around midnight.

starcatcher:pink_koi.name: Pink Koi
starcatcher:pink_koi.desc: A pink koi most commonly found in cherry groves. It comes out during rainy days to feed.

starcatcher:pipehead.name: Pipehead
starcatcher:pipehead.desc: This type of machine, sometimes called a pipesucker, is often used to connect different mechanisms underwater. It would appear this one got loose and started drifting the oceans.

starcatcher:purple_carp.name: Purple Carp
starcatcher:purple_carp.desc: This species of carp has adapted to the cold void of the End. It is said to make for a great stew, although no one is sure how to cook it.

starcatcher:pyrotrout.name: Pyrotrout
starcatcher:pyrotrout.desc: A trout adapted to live in the surface lava of the Overworld.

starcatcher:rainfin.name: Rainfin
starcatcher:rainfin.desc: A fish common to Overworld lakes only seen during rainy days. Unlike what its name would suggest, the fins are not made of rain.

starcatcher:redscaled_tuna.name: Redscaled Tuna
starcatcher:redscaled_tuna.desc: A large tuna with red colored scales. A single one of these often feeds an entire village.

starcatcher:ripple_catfish.name: Ripple Catfish
starcatcher:ripple_catfish.desc: A playful species of catfish, drawn to the gentle ripples of falling rain.

starcatcher:rockgill.name: Rockgill
starcatcher:rockgill.desc: A rock-hard fish common to the high mountains. It is said to make for a great stew, at least for those who have the teeth to bite through its skin.

starcatcher:rose_siamese_fish.name: Rose Siamese Fish
starcatcher:rose_siamese_fish.desc: A rare gorgeous fish found during rainy days. A decently challenging catch for even experienced anglers.

modifiers.text: Adjusts the penalty of missing sweet-spots by 300%
Adjusts the hp of fish by 75%

starcatcher:sage_catfish.name: Sage Catfish
starcatcher:sage_catfish.desc: A sage-colored catfish found in quiet swamps. It only comes out on clear nights, when the water is calm and still.

starcatcher:sandtail.name: Sandtail
starcatcher:sandtail.desc: A long sand-covered fish, found only in warm climates

starcatcher:scalding_pike.name: Scalding Pike
starcatcher:scalding_pike.desc: A predatory fish only found in the Nether.

starcatcher:scorched_bloodsucker.name: Scorched Bloodsucker
starcatcher:scorched_bloodsucker.desc: A hard to catch shrimp-like parasite found in deepslate lava lakes.

starcatcher:scorchfish.name: Scorchfish
starcatcher:scorchfish.desc: A fish species which despises the rain, preferring the warmer climate of the desert.

modifiers.text: Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 70%
Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 80%
Adjusts the chance of biting every tick by 130%
Deep Dark fish will be more likely to bite

starcatcher:sculkfish.name: Sculkfish
starcatcher:sculkfish.desc: A tricky fish corrupted by sculk.

starcatcher:sea_bass.name: Sea Bass
starcatcher:sea_bass.desc: A sea bass! No, wait—it's at least a C+!

starcatcher:seeking_worm.name: Seeking Worm
obtain: Bonemealing farmland may provide you with a few different items.

starcatcher:shadowfin.name: Shadowfin
starcatcher:shadowfin.desc: A grumpy fish that dislikes most others. It spends its days in the shadows, only leaving to meet its mossfin.

modifiers.text: You can no longer see your catch whilst fishing
A treasure spawns after 3 consecutive hits

starcatcher:shroomfish.name: Shroomfish
starcatcher:shroomfish.desc: An antique <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish species taken over by the spores of the mushroom islands. A really tasty dish for mushroom enjoyers.

starcatcher:silverfin_pike.name: Silverfin Pike
starcatcher:silverfin_pike.desc: A large pike common to rivers.

starcatcher:silverveil_perch.name: Silverveil Perch
starcatcher:silverveil_perch.desc: A small perch with scales resembling silver.

modifiers.text: Prevents the fish from swimming away once by bouncing it back up

starcatcher:sludge_catfish.name: Sludge Catfish
starcatcher:sludge_catfish.desc: A dirty catfish species common in murky swamp waters. It makes for a surprisingly good meal if cleaned properly.

starcatcher:spacejelly.name: Spacejelly
starcatcher:spacejelly.desc: An incredibly light pink jellyfish. It floats around the outer islands of the End in search of end cities.

modifiers.text: One extra fish will come alongside your catch

starcatcher:sporefish.name: Sporefish
starcatcher:sporefish.desc: A rare fish found in the mushroom islands, may prove a tough catch for inexperienced anglers.

starcatcher:starcatcher_guide.name: Starcatcher's Guide
starcatcher:starcatcher_guide.desc: An angler's best companion, keeping track of all the fishes you've caught, and those you have yet to reel in!

starcatcher:starcaught_fish.name: Starcaught Fish
starcatcher:starcaught_fish.desc: A starcaught fish, stripped from its uniqueness to fit with the rest of the stack. A shame it had to end this way really.

modifiers.text: Green sweet-spots will be slightly bigger
Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 120%
Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 160%
Prevents the fish from swimming away for a short period after a hit

starcatcher:stonefish.name: Stonefish
starcatcher:stonefish.desc: A huge heavy fish made of stone, often feeding miners for days. And breaking their teeth.

starcatcher:sun_seeking_carp.name: Sun Seeking Carp
starcatcher:sun_seeking_carp.desc: A rare sun-loving carp, seen only during daytime poking its head out the water.

starcatcher:suneater.name: Suneater
starcatcher:suneater.desc: A rare fish found in the lava lakes of the Overworld. It hunts down sunfish for food.

starcatcher:sunflower_carp.name: Sunflower Carp
starcatcher:sunflower_carp.desc: A specialized species of carp only found in sunflower fields.

starcatcher:sunny_sturgeon.name: Sunny Sturgeon
starcatcher:sunny_sturgeon.desc: A rare sturgeon often found high up in mountains during sunny days.

starcatcher:the_quarrish.name: The Quarrish
starcatcher:the_quarrish.desc: A fish often seen around the overgrown lush caves. Its heavy size makes for a very tedious catch.

starcatcher:thunder_bass.name: Thunder Bass
starcatcher:thunder_bass.desc: A rare species of bass drawn to the rumble of thunderstorms. Often seen swimming alongside a Lightning Bass.

starcatcher:tournament_stand.name: Tournament Stand
starcatcher:tournament_stand.desc: A stand used to host fishing tournaments.

starcatcher:twilight_koi.name: Twilight Koi
starcatcher:twilight_koi.desc: A rather rare species of Koi said to only come out to feed at night.

starcatcher:valve.name: Valve
starcatcher:valve.desc: A loose valve attached to a pipe. Somewhere, someone is wondering where it went.

modifiers.text: Restores vanilla fishing loot
Skips minigame if equipped alongsides the Vanilla-flavoured Bobber

starcatcher:vesani.name: Vesani
starcatcher:vesani.desc: This species of fish is really good at camouflaging as other species. It's unusual to see them out in the open with its normal appearance.

starcatcher:vivid_moss.name: Vivid Moss
starcatcher:vivid_moss.desc: A piece of moss resembling a fish found in lush caves. Or perhaps an actual fish consumed in moss? Either way it shouldn't give you much trouble catching it.

starcatcher:voidbiter.name: Voidbiter
starcatcher:voidbiter.desc: A <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish found floating in the vast void of the End. So few anglers have seen it that it is merely rumored to exist. If one were to catch it, it would be safe to assume they are an <scuncommon>Older Angler's</scuncommon> descendant.

starcatcher:voidfin.name: Voidfin
starcatcher:voidfin.desc: A pale purple fish known for its large fins used to glide the void.

starcatcher:ward.name: Ward
starcatcher:ward.desc: A <sclegendary>legendary</sclegendary> fish said to be best friends with The Warden. Instead of resisting sculk, this fish embraced it and became stronger for it.

modifiers.text: Adjusts the handle's rotation speed by 75%

starcatcher:whiteveil.name: Whiteveil
starcatcher:whiteveil.desc: A pale long-finned fish common underground. surprisingly heavy for what looks like a ghost.

starcatcher:willish.name: Willish
starcatcher:willish.desc: A fish known for scamming other fishes out of their food. It is incredibly ugly and should be discarded back to the Nether where it belongs.

starcatcher:willow_bream.name: Willow Bream
starcatcher:willow_bream.desc: A tricky catch only found during nighttime. Its blue scales makes it incredibly hard to track whilst reeling it in.

starcatcher:wintery_pike.name: Wintery Pike
starcatcher:wintery_pike.desc: A spiky predatory fish common beneath frozen lakes. Patient hunters have watched one stalk its prey for hours.

starcatcher:worm.name: Worm
obtain: Bonemealing farmland may provide you with a few different items.

modifiers.text: Adjusts minimum ticks to fish by 70%
Adjusts maximum ticks to fish by 80%
Adjusts the chance of biting every tick by 130%

starcatcher:yellowstone_fish.name: Yellowstone Fish
starcatcher:yellowstone_fish.desc: A beautiful gold colored fish common to dripstone caves.
